title: Privacy policy
intro: This is what the Mongmo app collects about you, why, who else handles it, how long we keep it, and what you can do about it. It describes what the app actually does, not what it might do.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Mongmo, Jan Palfijnstraat 26, 8500 Kortrijk, Belgium, is responsible for your data (the controller). Questions or requests: hello@mongmo-store.com.

sections.heading: What we collect, and why
paragraphs: Your account: your email address and password (stored hashed, never readable, by our sign-in provider), the name you choose, and, if you fill it in, your home city. Guests have no email or password. Why: to run your account (our contract with you).

Your orders: what you ordered, where and when you pick it up, the price and any reward you used. Why: to make and hand over your order (contract). Payments in the app are a test payment; no card details are collected.
Points, levels, badges and rewards: what you earned, from what, and what you redeemed. Why: the loyalty programme you join by signing up (contract).

Check-ins and challenges: which pop-up you checked in at and when, and the result of each challenge (a score, a rating, a vote, how many photos). Your location is used once to check you're at the pop-up and is not stored. Why: the programme (contract).
Photos you take for a challenge: stored privately; only you and Mongmo staff can see them. Why: the photo challenge you chose to do.
The leaderboard: your name and points are shown to other members, unless you turn it off in Settings. Why: the programme; you can opt out any time.

Crash reports, only if you said yes: when the app crashes, a report of what went wrong in the code, your phone model, system and app version. No name, email, location, or anything you typed. Why: your consent, which you can withdraw in Settings.

sections.heading: What stays on your phone
paragraphs: Nearby pop-up alerts use your phone's location in the background to notice when you're close to a pop-up; that happens on your phone and isn't sent to us. Notifications are created on your phone; we don't collect a push token. Your cart, settings and a copy of recent data (so the app opens offline) are kept on your phone. Your sign-in is kept in the phone's secure storage (Keychain or Keystore).

sections.heading: Who else handles it
paragraphs: Supabase hosts our database, sign-in and photo storage, as our processor.
Sentry receives crash reports, only if you said yes, as our processor.
Apple and Google run the app stores, your phone's location services, and the maps app that opens when you ask for directions.
Staff tools only: when Mongmo staff search for an address for a new pop-up, the search text goes to Photon (komoot) to find it.
We don't sell your data, use advertising networks, or track you across other apps and websites.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Unpaid draft orders: 1 day. Guest accounts not used: 30 days. Challenge photos: 12 months. Check-ins, challenge results and orders: 24 months. Rewards you've used: 24 months after you used them. Points history: as long as your account. Accounts not used for 24 months are deleted entirely. Crash reports: 30 days. Deletion happens automatically, every night.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: See and download your data: Settings → Your data → Download a copy.
Correct it: Account → Edit profile, and Settings for your email and password.
Delete it: Settings → Delete account. Your account, orders, points, badges, rewards, check-ins, challenge results and photos are deleted from our systems, not hidden.
Withdraw consent: Settings → Crash reports, any time.

You can also object to or ask us to limit how we use your data, by email. If you're unhappy with how we handle it, you can complain to the Belgian Data Protection Authority (www.dataprotectionauthority.be).

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: Everything is sent encrypted (HTTPS). Database rules mean each person can only reach their own data. Passwords are hashed. Your sign-in on the phone is kept in its secure storage.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: Mongmo isn't meant for children under 13, and we don't knowingly collect their data.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If we change what we collect, we'll update this page and its date, and tell you in the app before it applies.
